description: C++23 campaign foundation with strategic clocks and canonical strategic/tactical frame routing. Headless diagnostics retain campaign benchmarks and integrated Adaptive Research. An opt-in SDL3/Vulkan native galaxy preview displays the real 500-system campaign with mouse navigation and pause/speed controls; its runtime requires no Godot or .NET. Exports seal declared data and reviewed runtime dependencies. Full native player UI, audio, save/load orchestration, colony/system screens, tactical rendering and graphical parity remain open. State and timing outputs are diagnostics, not player saves or an FPS guarantee.
